reader_summary.overview: with Andrew Lo (@AndrewWLo) and Jorge Conde (@JorgeCondeBio) The advent of new gene and cell therapies are beginning to approach that holy grail of medicine—that of a possible cure.. But they are also more expensive than any medicines ever sold before. In this episode.

key_points.text: with Andrew Lo (@AndrewWLo) and Jorge Conde (@JorgeCondeBio) The advent of new gene and cell therapies are beginning to approach that holy grail of medicine—that of a possible cure..
If we think about these payments as a kind of 'mortgage for a cure,' what happens when your gene therapy mortgage defaults?
